Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City vyyvvg dilq.gov ph OILG OPINION NO. 80 s. 2025 'JUL OS 2025 ATTY. LUCH RICO GEMPIS, JR. Secretary to the City Council Manila Dear Atty. Gempis, Jr: This has reference to your letter dated February II, 2025, seeking enlightenment on the following issues: I. 2. Whether the Ordinance No. 9005 entitled "Adopting and Prescribing the Guidelines for Budgeting Process, Planning and Appropriation of the Sangguniang Kabataan Funds in Accordance with Existing Laws, Rules and Regulations" was enacted within the authority of the city council on 12 December 2024, as outlined in RA 7160, or is it considered ultra vires?; and Whether the Secretary to the City Council has the ministerial duty to certify that Ordinance No. 9095 is deemed approved considering that the written veto message of the mayor was received by the city council beyond the IO-day reglementary period provided by law. On your first query, we answer in the affirmative that the enactment of such ordinance is well within the Sangguniang Panlungsod's authority. Section 20 (d) of RA 10742 gives power to the Sangguniang Panlungsod to review annual budget and supplemental budget of the Sangguniang Kabataan on their compliance with existing laws, rules and regulations, thus — "(d) The Sangguniang Bayan or Sangguniang Panlungsod shall, within sixty (60) days upon receipt hereof, review the annual budget and supplemental budget of the Sangguniang Kabataan on their compliance in the immediately preceding provision and other existing laws, rules and regulations. Noncompliance shall render said budgets inoperative either in whole or in part. Failure on the part of the sanggunian to complete the review within the prescribed period shall render the said annual budget deemed approved. " In DILG-DBM-NYC Joint Circular No 1, Series Of 2019 provides for the guidelines on the appropriations, release, planning and budgeting process for the SK funds. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

"Item 3.3.4.1 The sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan, as the case may be, shall within sixty (60) days upon receipt review the annual/supplemental budget of the SK on their compliance with the priority programs, ptojects and activities identified under Section 20 (c) of R.A No. 10742, and with other existing laws, rules and regulations. 3.3.4.2 Depending on its findings, the sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan may render the following review actions: 3.3.4.2.1 The SK annual/supplemental budget may be declared operative in its entirety when it fully complies with the priority programs, projects, and activities identified under Section 20 (c) of RA No. 10742, and with otherexisting laws, rules and regulations. " From the foregoing, it is clear that the Sangguniang Panlungsod may enact ordinance on adopting and prescribing the guidelines for Budgeting Process, Planning and Appropriation of the Sangguniang Kabataan Funds as it is well within their authority to do so being the reviewing authority of the Sangguniang Kabataan. Hence, the assailed ordinance is deemed acted within the authority of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. As to the second query, we answer in the affirmative as the ten-day period is mandatory. The ten-day period under Section 54 (b) of the LGC, within which the LCE may exercise veto power is considered as mandatory. Considering that ordinances are enacted to appropriately respond to the demands and aspirations of the community and, therefore, imbued with public interest and to certain extent, the designation of the ten-day period for the mayor to communicate his veto is considered as a limitation on his veto power To resolve otherwise would defeat the ordinance-making power of the Sanggunian by the mere inaction of the LCE.I From the foregoing, it is this Department's view that the Secretary to the Council's duty is ministerial as the veto was made after the lapse of the ten-day period This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have provided you sufficient guidance on the matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P.
